description: Guided implementation for approved Braze demo app stories in the pack-driven Lumo Android, iOS, and web runtime.

interface.shortDescription: Build pack-driven Braze demo app stories with guided Lumo setup.
interface.longDescription: Guides Codex through credible implementation of an approved Braze demo app story across demo packs, the web render surface, the Control Room, and native Android/iOS SDK shells. Routes incomplete story shaping to the source-distributed solution campaign, then keeps builds repeatable with placement contracts, platform parity checks, and final Lumo handoff notes.
defaultPrompt: Run /demo-build to build or update a Braze demo app story.
